steps.input:
import numpy as np
g = np.array(grid)
colors = sorted(set(g[g>0].tolist()))
ys8, xs8 = np.where(g==8)
target_top = ys8.min()
out = np.zeros_like(g)
for c in colors:
    ys, xs = np.where(g==c)
    top, bottom, left, right = ys.min(), ys.max(), xs.min(), xs.max()
    sub = g[top:bottom+1, left:right+1]
    shift = top - target_top
    out[top-shift:top-shift+sub.shape[0], left:left+sub.shape[1]] = sub
# verify each color count preserved
for c in colors:
    assert (g==c).sum() == (out==c).sum()
print(out.tolist())
